generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the envelope was built.

ok.description: `true` when every run's report is ok.

CheckResult.description: Result produced by running a single check.

kind.description: Set on synthetic rows only; absent means `"check"`.

findings.description: The record-level findings behind the verdict, when the check reports them. Omitted when there are none; capped at 500 by the runner.

findingsTruncated.description: How many findings were dropped by the cap.

CheckResultKind.description: Who produced a result row: a check (`"check"`, the default when absent), the runner itself (`"runner"`: the duplicate-name and empty-selection guards) or the baseline (`"baseline"`: expired-entry notices).

CheckStatus.description: Outcome of a single preflight check.

Finding.description: One record-level finding behind a check's verdict.

message.description: One line; never echoes secrets or matched source text.

status.description: Verdict of this finding; defaults to the row's status.

FindingLocation.description: Where a finding lives: a record (table + sys_id + field, optionally a line in a script) or, for subjects that are not a single record, a logical id (`"scope/slug"`, `"instance"`, `"app:<scope>"`).

table.description: Table of the offending record, e.g. `"sys_script_include"`.

recordName.description: Display label of the record (`name`, falling back to the sys_id).

field.description: Field holding the offending value, e.g. `"script"`.

logicalId.description: Identity of a subject that is not one record.

PreflightReport.description: Aggregate outcome of a full preflight run.

ok.description: `true` when no check returned a `fail` status.

ReportRun.description: One instance's run inside the envelope.

instance.description: Registry instance name (`dev`…); absent for an ad-hoc `--instance` run.

url.description: The instance origin (`https://host`), without credentials or a path.
